Name: Harvest Moon Witch Princess Mod
Author: SasaraYT
Description:
[size=3]Hello everyone!
[/size]
This mod is switching the Wizard to the Witch Princess from the Harvest Moon series.

Please download the latest version from SMAPI: https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases

[size=4]Changes:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Character Sprite also kiss and wedding sprites![/size]
[*][size=2]Character Dialogues[/size]
[*][size=2]Character Portrait[/size]
[*][size=2]Date and Mariable[/size]
[*][size=2]English and German support![/size]
[*][size=2]Her own Sprouseroom[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[url=https://github.com/Sasara2201/WitchPrincess]Sourcecode[/url]
[/size][size=2]
[/size]PORTRAITURE IS INCLUDED WITH [b]PERSONAL PERMISSIONS[/b] FROM [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42440425]Platonymous[/url] (mod files included in the download)
Portraiture just adds some high-res portraits to my mod, its [b]not[/b] needed if you dont like it!
There will still be normal Witch Princess portraits when you dont use Portraiture!

for more infos look at the Portraiture mod page : http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999/?

To use Portraiture just press "P" until you see "Witch Princess"

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/301688466687655936/312940368931061761/unknown.png[/img]


There is at the moment only the Option to show the Name "Witch Princess", this will change in a future version of the mod!


[b]
This mod is slightly under-tested. If you encounter any issues, PLEASE let me know! Thanks!

Please read the README included!! [/b]

Downloads.Description:
Need SMAPI 2.11+

Works with SDV 1.3+


This mods replace the Wizard to the Witch Princess from Harvest Moon, Witch Princess is shown as Name.
